answer_1.quote: We propose SQUiD, a neurosymbolic framework for the Text2R task... programmatically translates the structured outputs into valid SQL statements, ensuring syntactic correctness and structural fidelity.
answer_1.outputs: SQL statements (CREATE TABLE, INSERT), relational schema definitions, populated database tuples

answer_2.quote: We propose a suite of novel metrics for a principled evaluation of the Text2R task... Schema Evaluation... Tuple Evaluation... We evaluate the quality of generated database schemas along three dimensions... We propose five novel metrics to evaluate the quality of the generated tuples...

answer_4.quote: We also conducted a small-scale evaluation on real text from WikiBio , CNN-DM manually annotating 10 entries per dataset to evaluate SQUiD.
answer_4.guideline: Manual annotation of generated databases to assess correctness and completeness
